archetypes.name: state-machine
archetypes.rationale: Resume routing adds a multi-branch state machine whose precedence and transitions need focused review beyond generic structure.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the resume-plan classification as a state machine, including blocked continuation, checkout mismatch, fresh, open-pr, merged, and done paths. Look for unreachable branches, precedence inversions, accidental fallthrough, or paths that write state before validation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: gh-authority
archetypes.rationale: The change depends on GitHub PR state and head-ref validation matching local checkout state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the integration between local persisted state, current branch probing, and GitHub PR lookup. Check whether normal-repo routes consistently treat successful GitHub state as authoritative and require matching PR head before non-fresh resume. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: counter-durability
archetypes.rationale: Session-wide CI counters must survive resume, terminal handbacks, cap checks, and monitor increments.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace iteration, rebase, fix-attempt, and transient-retry counters from state parsing through monitor entry, monitor exit, terminal state writes, rebase loops, and postmerge paths. Look for places restored counters can be reset, increments can be lost, or cap ordering can stall before observing success. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: mode-hydration
archetypes.rationale: Durable mode flags control gh skipping, PR-only exits, fork handling, and protected-branch safety.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine how durable flags such as repo-unavailable, forked-target, forked, merge, and draft are read, hydrated into RunContext, and reused across resume paths. Check for stale argv/context values leaking into PR operations, state writes, GitHub skip decisions, or early PR-only exits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: branch-guard
archetypes.rationale: Resume safety depends on refusing unsafe protected-branch or mismatched-checkout execution before mutating workflow phases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review branch validation and protected-branch refusal behavior for state-present resumes, including detached or unprobeable checkouts, mismatched branches, and main/master carve-outs for forked targets. Focus on whether unsafe checkouts can fall through to fresh work, CI, PR creation, or postmerge operations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
